summary.text: Customers find this water heater to be the best in the market, appreciating its attractive LED display light, easy installation, and suitability for daily use. The heating speed is positive, with one customer noting it provides 3 liters of hot water within a minute, and they consider it a budget-friendly option. The performance receives mixed feedback - while some say it functions well, others report it stops working after three months.
